task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger dashboard using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or home screen of wger is visible, showing the 'admin' user profile or a logout button.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the workout routines management section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of workout routines is displayed, including '5x5 Beginner', 'Push-Pull-Legs', and 'Upper-Lower Split'.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the '5x5 Beginner' routine for deletion.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a delete icon/button next to '5x5 Beginner' or opens its specific management page to find the delete option.

task_completion.description: Agent confirms the deletion in the system prompt or confirmation page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation dialog or a 'Delete' button on a confirmation page is clicked specifically for the '5x5 Beginner' routine.

task_completion.description: The '5x5 Beginner' routine is no longer present in the list, while others remain.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine list is shown again; '5x5 Beginner' is absent, but 'Push-Pull-Legs' and 'Upper-Lower Split' are still visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and browser navigation rather than a terminal window with SQL or Django shell commands.

integrity.description: The agent did not delete the 'Push-Pull-Legs' or 'Upper-Lower Split' routines.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final screenshots of the routine list still show 'Push-Pull-Legs' and 'Upper-Lower Split' as active entries.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual wger application elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar shows localhost and the wger UI elements (buttons, forms) change state in response to agent actions.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The system initially contains exactly three routines: '5x5 Beginner', 'Push-Pull-Legs', and 'Upper-Lower Split'. The goal is to delete ONLY '5x5 Beginner'. Success is defined by a final state where 'Push-Pull-Legs' and 'Upper-Lower Split' are the only two routines remaining in the list.
